Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
 Your Role
 As a French speaking Java Developer , you will design, develop and evolve reliable Java applications that support our clients' business needs. You will work within a collaborative delivery environment, contributing throughout the software development lifecycle.
Design and develop maintainable Java applications and software components.
Deliver and enhance features while ensuring code quality, reliability and maintainability.
Collaborate with technical, functional and client-facing teams to understand requirements and translate them into effective solutions.
Contribute to code reviews, testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement across the development lifecycle.
 Your Profile
Hands-on experience developing applications using Java and solid knowledge of object-oriented programming.
Good understanding of software engineering practices, testing, version control and application development lifecycles.
Ability to analyse technical requirements, troubleshoot issues and contribute effectively within a collaborative development team.
Professional French is mandatory, as you will need to communicate effectively in French within the project environment.
Good English communication skills are an advantage.
 What You Will Love About Working Here
Software Engineer Community: Join a global community of 100,000+ software engineering professionals and expand your network through client and executive interactions.
Diverse & Impactful Projects: Develop your expertise across a wide range of missions, technologies, and sectors, with meaningful autonomy and room for initiative.
Continuous Learning: Access comprehensive training platforms and recognized certifications.
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from hybrid working policies that allow you to manage your time and work location effectively.
